job.question: Which pension system's investment consultant RFP requires respondents to have at least five defined benefit pension plan clients, two of which are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $15 billion each?
job.expected_facts: Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS), in its 2021 investment consultant services RFP (Appendix E, Minimum Qualifications Certification).
job.acceptance: OCERS/Orange County Employees Retirement System suffices. Appendix designation, year and restatement of qualification are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Hawaii ERS private equity consultant RFP, not an OCERS investment consultant services RFP. Its client qualification requires one public retirement system defined benefit client with assets greater than $3 billion, not five defined benefit clients including two public plans with at least $15 billion each.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii Request for Proposals Private Equity Consultant Services RFP 2022-04 Issued AUGUST 29, 2022
Offeror provides investment consulting services to at least one public retirement system defined benefit client with assets greater than $3 billion.
